limitations: One Apple M1 Max host; no affinity, thermal or power control.
Five seconds means rendered audio per call, not wall-clock measurement duration.
Only four fixed workloads; reported statistics and checksums are not full sample-trace equivalence.
Always-on version-2 transport adds cost to legacy patches without Stock Mid/Side.
Small mixed 16-voice differences are near observed within-run variation.
Build source/flags are caller-recorded provenance; executable/catalog checks alone cannot prove source identity.

compile_latency.reason: Existing MCP benchmark compiles before its timer; this harness adds no compilation timer or custom Core driver

method.correctness: Before timing, exact reported analyze_signal JSON statistics excluding revision only; every warmup and timed checksum must match exactly
method.limitations: Four fixed workloads on one host; no callback/device/UI/SDK measurements, affinity/thermal/power control or full sample-trace equivalence; no performance advantage claim
method.order: Deterministically shuffled workload order each round; baseline first in even zero-based rounds, candidate first in odd rounds
method.timing_scope: Server benchmark Instant measures DSP and checksum reduction; excludes compilation, patch replacement and RPC

rejected_before_timing.correction: Build candidate into isolated candidate-target; require 74 kinds and stock_mid_side before benchmark.
rejected_before_timing.reason: Shared target directory returned existing baseline executable unchanged; hashes identical and baseline catalog has 73 kinds. No candidate timing was accepted.

scope: Incremental canonical version-2 host-port transport overhead against OpenPatch main; offline four-workload experiment
selection: Retain final small single-cable implementation after bounded four-attempt investigation. Stop tuning; disclose always-on legacy cost. Differences among mono optimizations do not establish a material speedup.

source_provenance.authority: Caller-supplied build provenance, not inferred from binary or current compiler
source_provenance.build_isolation_requirement: Build baseline, candidate and final shipping artifact in separate target directories. A successful or fresh Cargo result against a shared target does not establish which source produced the executable; validate binary hashes and actual catalogs before analysis/timing.
source_provenance.profile: release; caller must verify identical build flags
source_provenance.rustflags: unset; target/profile/wrapper overrides unset; identical lockfile and workspace profile
